name: Zechariah (son of Jehoiada)
title: Priest who was stoned in the temple courtyard
summary: Zechariah was the son of the high priest Jehoiada. When he rebuked the people and King Joash for their apostasy, he was stoned to death in the courtyard of the Lord's house by order of the king—a judicial murder that Jesus later referred back to.

keyEvents.title: Stoned for his prophetic word
keyEvents.description: Zechariah warned the people not to abandon the Lord, but was stoned in the courtyard of the Lord's house by order of King Joash, who forgot the kindness that his father Jehoiada had shown him.
